crossRefs.note: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
“Now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that Yahweh spoke this word…
As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now…
The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow…
But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’
translations.bsb: he said to them, “I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to come and go, and the LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, I am a hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: and Jehovah hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
